svg.aria-label: Judgement. 41% of findings named no attacker. I re-judged a sample against the source and added a filing gate: name the attacker, what they gain, and prove the code is reachable. It cut findings by about 70%, but live precision stayed at 8%. I published that instead of the 72% offline score, which is why I built the judge eval. Result: ~70% fewer findings filed, and an honest 8% reported.
